title: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
hook: 在爷爷的花园里，Peppa 想当蝴蝶，George 和爷爷却抢着当蚯蚓，最后一起当青蛙跳泥坑。

cells.q: What were Peppa and George doing?
cells.a: They were helping Grandpa Pig in his garden.
cells.cn: 他们在爷爷的花园里帮忙。

cells.q: What did Grandpa say about the butterfly?
cells.a: He said its tongue is even longer than Peppa's.
cells.cn: 他说蝴蝶的舌头比 Peppa 的还长。

cells.t: I Want to Be a Butterfly
cells.q: What did Peppa want to be?
cells.a: She said, “She is so pretty. I want to be a butterfly.”
cells.cn: 她说蝴蝶真漂亮，她想当蝴蝶。

cells.q: Did George want to be a worm?
cells.a: No, he did not want to be a worm at all.
cells.cn: 不，他一点也不想想当蚯蚓。

cells.q: What were George and Grandpa doing?
cells.a: They were having fun being wriggly worms.
cells.cn: 他们扭来扭去装蚯蚓，玩得很开心。

cells.a: She asked, “Grandpa! George! What are you doing?”
cells.cn: 她问：“爷爷！George！你们在干什么？”

cells.a: He asked, “What animal do you want to be now?”
cells.cn: 他问：“现在想当什么动物？”

cells.a: She wondered, “Do frogs play dolls' houses?”
cells.cn: 她想知道青蛙玩不玩娃娃家。

cells.a: They found a nice big muddy puddle to play in.
cells.cn: 它们找到一个大泥坑，正好在里面玩。

ending: In the end, the froggies jump in a big muddy puddle. My favourite part is ______.
